description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER 'ciaddr' field is 0 in INIT — the client has no bound address to advertise (RFC 2131 §4.4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
In INIT the client has no IP yet; setting ciaddr to anything but 0 would mislead servers into thinking the client already has a binding to renew. RFC 2131 §4.4.1 makes ciaddr=0 mandatory in this state.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT starts in INIT.
2. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • ciaddr == 0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's BOOTP ciaddr field is all-zero.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_ciaddr_nonzero — DISCOVER carries non-zero ciaddr (state-leak from a prior bound lease)
• Fail_no_discover — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_ciaddr_nonzero: DUT DHCPDISCOVER ciaddr is not zero
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
